description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Prompt, which provides authentication callback implementations for use with SVN and git-svn. It includes methods for handling username, password, SSL certificate trust, client certificates, and prompts for user input during authentication processes.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles basic username and password prompt, sets credentials, and optionally saves login.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Handles SSL server trust validation, displays certificate info, prompts user for acceptance.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts for SSL client certificate filename and sets it.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for SSL client certificate password and sets it.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts for username if not predefined, sets it in credentials.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads a password from stdin with prompt.
